Hello! My name is Krisanat Anukarnsakulchularp, or you can call me Otto. My sister drew my profile picture inspired by my favourite animal.

I'm currently a PhD student at Monash University in the Econometrics and Business Statistics department. My research interests are in network data structure and visualization.

I'm also helping organise the Hacky-Hour session, which is like a "getaway" for me.
